''See also: [[Erin Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Erin is a small continent that was historically situated between the territories of [[Othaghor]] and [[Tharlos, the Formless Legion|Tharlos]], which were once engaged in a perpetual conflict involving life and chaos. The region is characterized by its [[Erinin plains]], which contain massive stone obelisks that have existed for millennia. These monuments were excavated by human slaves working under the influence of [[Othaghor]]'s [[Intent]]. The continent features various locations, such as [[Kalvin’s Rest]], a port town in the north where locals may view outsiders with suspicion. There are also political tensions within Erin, as some groups have expressed desires for secession and independence from [[The Empire|the Empire]]. People of [[Erinin]] descent are noted as a distinct social group, and some individuals from this region have mixed bloodlines involving [[Izyrian]] ancestry.}}
